analysis: Paired common future streams; equal selected-state means within regime/stratum. Descriptive2000resample recording-cluster percentile intervals conditional on selected states, at most4clusters/regime; report sparse/degenerate limits. No whole-episode learning or reliable-discovery claim.
authorization: RUN1 four-hour user authorization; root approved bounded branch design before outcomes. No mutation or other model calls from this unit.
candidate_operation_definition: One public-observation update plus learned planner is one operation; every extra replacement-law planner is one more. Includes selection, warmup and continuation. Each future job reserves its maximum cost before launch; any budget shortfall is reported unstarted.
data_scope: Exposed development fitting-subvalidation records only; no assessment cases; reconstructed transitions are repeated execution, branches new bounded development consequences.
duplicate_actions: Collapse identical firstactions; alias outcomes by label. Agreement controls are zero-treatment comparisons by construction, not separate repeatability trials.
focused_checks: 4 synthetic tests passed before execution; no complete environment or candidate episodes in tests.
intervention_scope: Same observed selected memory after WM; discarded copies replace only forecast movement law with uniforminitialprior/currenttruelaw. Main learned planner checkpoint is restored for every action branch; force first action only, then unchanged learned policy on branch observations. Replacement-copy target writes discarded.
invalid_policy: Retain attempted branch with return=-1.12 and failure_or_invalid=1; collision=False records no observed collision, report invalid count separately. Preserve complete prior branches; no retries.
randomness: Independent run1:branch:{state}:{replicate} streams; identical future uniforms paired across first actions, exactly3enemy draws/transition. Original hidden law/switch/wall schedule retained.
selection: Lexicographic regime/case/frame traversal; visible anonymous enemy, observation step>=10, at least2 legal currently-empty destinations using observed terrain. Earliest4agreement and4disagreement states/regime; max2states/case, at least8frame separation. No outcome-based replacement or quota relaxation.
